IC1: Anaphylactic reaction [AND] to a previous dose of TIV(trivalent influenza vaccine)
IC2: Known IgE( Immunoglobulin E)-mediated hypersensitivity  [AND]to eggs manifested as hives, [OR] swelling of the mouth and throat, [OR] difficulty in breathing, [OR] hypotension, [OR] or shock
IC3: Guillain-Barré syndrome within eight weeks of a previous influenza vaccine
IC5: Patients who have had influenza vaccine in two of the three previous years
